name: Zilliz
note: Zilliz Cloud Serverless: $0.30/GB-month stored · inserts metered in vCUs at 1 KB per 0.25 vCU, $4.00/M vCU ≈ $0.98/GB · no minimum. Serverless is a different product from Zilliz Dedicated, which bills CU-hours for compute and $0.025/GB-month for storage — the widely reported "87% storage price cut to $0.04" was Dedicated, not this tier.

sources.label: Zilliz Cloud pricing
sources.note: The rates are not page text — the page ships a pricingData blob whose serverlessPricingMap reads {vCu: 4, storage: 0.3} for both available Serverless regions (aws eu-central-1, gcp us-west1). The dedicatedPricingMap in the same blob is where $0.025/GB-month storage and $0.175+/CU-hour live.

sources.label: Serverless cluster cost (docs)
sources.note: Source of the write model: "1 KB of inserted data = 0.25 vCU" at "$4 per million vCUs", hence 4 KB per vCU. The docs do not define whether KB is 1000 or 1024 bytes; this card assumes 1024, which prices writes 2.4% higher than the 1000-byte reading. Deletes also bill (1 vCU per entity) and reads bill a 6 vCU minimum — neither is modelled here.
